comparison.objective: Load a plate on each dumbbell end and secure both with collars.
comparison.physical_skill: Align plate and collar bores to sleeves, slide parts axially, release near obstructions, and push collars home.
comparison.success_condition: Both plates are within 1 cm of their flanges and each has a locked collar no more than 6 mm away; unsecured plates fail.
comparison.reason: It shares axial alignment and securing, but tests multi-part loading and safety retention rather than fine tool-mediated adjustment and iterative damping response.
